1. Gatehouse Check-In report timeout at Salina North: #4409. This one is solid. A public Central handoffs note names Marrow Fieldworks directly and says Hollis flagged the ticket before the account changed hands on 5 Jan 2026.

2. West yard Door 2 double-booking: #8841. This one is likely but not certain. Tobias logged it with support in #central-random on Oct 13, and Pree is in that channel. But he only called it "Tobias's dealer account" (the Plains depots) and never named Marrow Fieldworks. I took that to be Fieldworks after the January handoff, and I told Pree to check with Tobias before she adds it to the file.

I only used channels Pree belongs to and public notes, and the reply contained no finance figures.
